title: Lenny audit event (schema v1)
description: Per-version registry of the §11.7 hash-chained audit_log canonical record. event_schema_version 'v1' matches the audit_log column default (migrations/0001). This schema describes the canonical Postgres-tuple view a verifier reconstructs the per-tenant hash chain from; the on-the-wire OCSF projection is described by the OCSF class/activity mapping in schemas/ocsf-mapping.yaml.

tenant_id.description: Per-tenant chain selector. The pseudo-tenant 'platform' carries platform-admin actions.

sequence_number.description: Monotonic per-tenant sequence number; the chain orders rows by (tenant_id, sequence_number).

event_type.description: Lenny event type. Maps to an OCSF class/activity via schemas/ocsf-mapping.yaml; an event type with no mapping dead-letters as class_mapping_missing.

event_schema_version.description: Schema version of this record. Pins the verifier to this registry file.

payload.description: Complete Lenny-internal event payload. Fields with an explicit OCSF mapping are projected onto OCSF objects; all other keys route verbatim into unmapped.lenny.*.

prev_hash.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 chain link to the predecessor row. Null/absent only on the first row of a tenant chain, where the per-tenant genesis hash is used instead.

genesis_nonce.description: 256-bit hex nonce present on the first row of a tenant chain only. genesis_hash = SHA-256("lenny-audit-genesis" || tenant_id || genesis_nonce).

chain_integrity.description: Verifier state for the chain segment containing this row, per §11.7.
